The '''Jendiria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Maldrood sector/Legends|Maldrood sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] [[Jendirian Valley/Legends|''Jendirian Valley'']]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|155|''Jendirian Valley''}}</ref> and ''[[Jendirian Valley III]]''.<ref name="Millennium Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Jendiria system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square R-7.<ref name="TEA" />
